column2: The M.I. detachment has been deployed on Gehenna and receives its first assignment: Soil samples have to be extracted in a sector infested by Arachnids.
Complete 4 Sample Sites before the mercenaries

// NAME: // Note: Don't translate names starting with #
// ============== /OBJECTIVES/INVESTIGATE SAMPLE SITES/TRIGGERS/POINT 1 INVESTIGATION/POINT 1 EVENTS/ACTIVATE PROSPECTOR > OBJECTIVE ==============

column2: Bugs will zero in on the drilling vibrations. Form a defensive perimeter - we're going to have company!
It's fully automated. Just protect it while it extracts the sample.
Engineers have arrived to set up the prospector. As soon as it's done, we can start the sample extraction.
I see the second prospector has been activated.  That's valuable HephaeStar property. Keep it protected.
Come on troopers, on to the next objective. We're not going to let some merc rabble outdo us.
Last site this way. Let's get this done, Mobile Infantry!
What level of resistance can we expect?
We have reports of intense Arachnid activity in the area, so keep an eye out. And good luck, Captain.
Gehenna. Another old name for Hell. Guess they didn’t just pick the name at random.
We're drilling core samples to locate sites for new mining facilities. Clear and defend designated areas until a sample is collected.
So much for the unbeatable Mobile Infantry. Return to the station, captain. Our security contractors will finish the rest of this operation.
We need to speed up the operation. I'm sending in a group of our contractors to handle the northern sites.
With respect, ma’am, the Mobile Infantry can handle the mission objectives.

Relax, Fed man. Plenty of Bugs to go round.
You stay out our way, and we'll stay out yours.
Troopers, move up! Let’s show them the M.I. gets things done.
All sample sites have been processed.
First sample in the bag. We’re catching up on you, Fed.
I remember you now. The merc leading the Bugs back on Vilon.
Sorry - that's above your pay grade.
Fraser here. Our next site is just ahead. We'll move in after we've cleared the valley.
My men have collected another soil sample. Try to keep up, Fed man.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/MERCENARY RACE/MERCENARY PROGRESS/POINT 5 > 4/BRIEFING IF PLAYER IS NOT ON THE FINALE SITE ==============

column2: Third location done. Race you to the final site.
We should wipe out that Bug hive before we proceed to the next site.
Upper caves cleared, but there's an extensive tunnel network leading deep into the mountains.
A hive this large will require substantial reinforcements to fully exterminate.
I've got nuke techs on my team, Director. Give me a couple of warheads and I’ll have that place lit up within the hour.
Very well. I'll extend your contract to cover destroying the hive. Captain Zhao, your troops can stand down for now.
Director, Captain Zhao reporting. We have encountered a large Bug hive at the last site.
That must be the source of all Arachnid activity in the sector. You’ll have to clear it out. This is now the mission priority.
Very well. We’ll get the job done.
Heads up, Fed. Our seismic sensors show something big near you. Watch out.
We're Mobile Infantry. Real soldiers. Whatever it is, we can handle it.
